svg.title: Training, validation and test sets for synthetic-10x
svg.desc: From left to right: 1,040 training images, 260 validation images and the same 1243 external test images for every condition. Train and validation use two cards per 26 images, rounded to the nearest integer; the test deck is capped and its size carries no comparison. Photos illustrate data types. Card spacing compresses in larger groups. All diagrams have equal width and fixed group starting positions.
